summary: ReposiTrak, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to a services agreement with SPAR Group, Inc., allowing payment in cash or stock. On May 29, 2026, ReposiTrak elected stock, receiving 3,190,569 shares at $0.728710119 per share, valued at $2,325,000. This is a routine commercial election, not a strategic acquisition or special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or unusual structural features are noted. The disclosure merely formalizes a payment method choice under an existing agreement.
